description_expanded: This Alys Beach Vacation Home is a short walk to all Alys Beach Amenities including our emerging Town Center. Guests will find a private courtyard with pool that offers open and covered seating as well as outdoor dining. The family room with beautiful natural wood accents offers ample seating and a wet bar with small refrigerator. The kitchen features a large center island with bar-style seating. Guest will find the primary suite with king-sized bed on the first level with an additional entrance to the courtyard. On the second level, guests will find a small tv lounge with additional seating, and two bedrooms, each with private baths. One of these bedrooms has one king bed and the other has two queen-sized beds. Finally, a roof-top terrace with grill completes this level. The fourth bedroom with a king-sized bed and private bath is detached from the main house and accessible by a stairway from the courtyard. Parking for this home is located in two designated spaces in a parking court. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
